defense_news.title: Cost estimate for Iran war rises to more than $47 billion
defense_news.summary: The U.S. military has spent about 25% more on the war in Iran than estimates projected in July, according to Pentagon data obtained by Reuters.

defense_news.title: US costs of Iran war rise to over $47 billion, according to Pentagon estimate
defense_news.summary: The U.S. military has spent over $47 billion so far to prosecute the war in Iran, more than 25% higher than the Defense Department's estimate in July.
